added: Re-import choreography can now take a Caller's Box or ContraDB link or ID number, so a dance whose title is spelled differently at the source (A-1 Reel against your A1 Reel) can still be refreshed.
changed: When Re-import choreography cannot reach a source, or the dance does not exist there, it now says which, instead of a general "could not load" message.
Re-import choreography now refuses a dance that arrives without any figures (The Caller's Box withholds them for some dances), instead of replacing your figures with an empty list.

added: `DedupeVerdict.possibleMatchIds`, filled by `DedupeIndex.possibleTitleMatches`: existing dances with the same `dedupeCoreTitleKey` (trailing `{…}`/`(…)`/`[…]` annotations dropped, `A-1` read as `a1`) and a shared author but a different `normalizeTitle`. It never changes a verdict's kind or candidates and is never confident. `normalizeTitle` is unchanged.
